description_en: Updates the index information of a Logstore
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-index --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIndex

parameters.name: keys

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the field is case-sensitive
fields.name: case_sensitive

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the field contains Chinese characters
fields.name: chn

fields.help_en: Indicates whether auto index is enabled for all text fields in JSON
fields.help_zh: 是否对Json内所有文本字段自动索引
fields.name: index_all

fields.help_en: Indicates whether Chinese characters are included
fields.name: chn

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the automatic index discovery feature. After this feature is enabled, fields in logs that do not have indexes are automatically discovered and added to auto_text_keys (automatically discovered indexed fields). The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type with analytics enabled. Their case sensitivity and token settings inherit the full-text index configuration
fields.help_zh: 是否开启索引自动发现功能。开启后会自动发现日志中未添加索引的字段，并添加到 auto_text_keys （自动发现的索引字段）内。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置
fields.name: auto_key_detect

fields.help_en: The automatically discovered indexed fields. The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type with analytics enabled. Their case sensitivity and token settings inherit the full-text index configuration. After automatic index discovery is disabled, the previously discovered indexes are retained unless you explicitly clear this field
fields.help_zh: 自动发现的索引字段。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。关闭自动发现索引后，原自动发现的索引将继续保留，除非显式清空此字段
fields.name: auto_text_keys

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the index is case-sensitive. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否大小写敏感。默认值为 false
fields.name: case_sensitive

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include Chinese characters. Default value: false. Enabling this option may reduce write performance
fields.help_zh: 是否包含中文。默认值为 false，开启包含中文后，写入能力可能会有一定下降
fields.name: chn

fields.help_en: The list of excluded fields. This parameter cannot be specified together with include_keys
fields.help_zh: 排除的字段列表，不能与include_keys同时指定
fields.name: exclude_keys

fields.help_en: The list of included fields. This parameter cannot be specified together with exclude_keys
fields.help_zh: 包含的字段列表，不能与exclude_keys同时指定
fields.name: include_keys

fields.help_en: The list of token delimiters. You can set a token parameter to specify how the field is tokenized
fields.help_zh: 分词符列表。可以设置一个分词参数，指定这个字段按照哪一种方式分词
fields.name: token

parameters.help_en:
The full-text index configuration. At least one of the following must exist: full-text index, field index, or scan index.
Full-text index example:
```
{
    "chn": false,
    "caseSensitive": false,
    "token":[","," ","'","\"",";","=","(",")","[","]","{","}","?","@","<","&","/",":","\n","\t","\r"]
}
```
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable LogReduce. After LogReduce is enabled, at most one of the whitelist and blacklist takes effect.

true: LogReduce is enabled.
false (default): LogReduce is not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志聚类。开启后白名单与黑名单至多生效其中一个。

true：开启日志聚类。
false（默认值）：不开启日志聚类
parameters.name: log_reduce

parameters.help_en: The blacklist for filtering clustering fields in LogReduce. This parameter takes effect only when LogReduce is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤黑名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效
parameters.name: log_reduce_black_list

parameters.help_en: The whitelist for filtering clustering fields in LogReduce. This parameter takes effect only when LogReduce is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤白名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效
parameters.name: log_reduce_white_list

parameters.help_en: Simple Log Service sets the maximum length of a field value to 2,048 bytes (2 KB) by default. To change the maximum length of a field value, set the maximum length of a statistics field (text). Valid values: 64 to 16384. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务默认字段值的最大长度为2048字节，即2 KB。如果您需要修改字段值的最大长度，可设置统计字段（text）最大长度，取值范围为64~16384字节
parameters.name: max_text_len

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable scan index. At least one of the following must exist: full-text index, field index, or scan index
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启扫描索引。全文索引、字段索引、扫描索引至少需要存在一个
parameters.name: scan_index
